```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_standardized_scores
title: >
  New Scores
questions:
  - id: transformed_standard_score
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      A score has $z = 2$. It is transformed to a reporting scale with mean 100 and
      standard deviation 15. What is the transformed score?
    options:
      - text: >
          115
      - text: >
          120
      - text: >
          130
        correct: true
      - text: >
          145
    explanation: >
      Use $Y=A+Bz=100+15\times2=130$.
```
